Anya: Quick sync 1 May webinar format idea: 12-15min keynote + three 12min micro-breakouts. more focused leads per breakout.
Jordan: yes, helps SDR routing. suggest breakouts: cost optimization, private deployments, observability/evals.
Sam: agree. each breakout should have one 30s demo clip + 1-slide prompt.
Mira: can do demo for private deployments; will need sanitized sample by Wed.
Anya: tentative run-of-show:
00:00 Intro (Anya) 4m
04:00 Keynote (Anya) 15m
19:00 Quick breakout intros 3m
22:00 Breakouts A/B/C (12m)
34:00 Regroup highlights 6m
40:00 Panel QA 12m
52:00 Close & CTAs 8m
Jordan: scheduling: rehearsal Thu 9am PT. can everyone confirm?
Sam: confirmed.
Mira: confirmed.
Kai: will reserve staging infra and provide ephemeral staging endpoint and key.
ops-bot: Rehearsal event created for 2025-05-15T16:00Z. runbook link in #marketing-resources.

Sam: CTA draft for cost breakout: "Reduce per-request token cost with intelligent batching + cache."
Mira: private CTA: "Secure inference in your VPC with audit-grade controls."
Jordan: obs CTA: "Spot regressions quickly with prompt-driven evals."
Anya: registration form will capture breakout choice for routing. SDR owners: Sam -> cost, Mira -> private, Jordan -> observability.
Sam: rehearsal failover note: if live stream stalls, switch to prerecorded 90s clips and note in chat.
Mira: designate triage lead in each room to collect top 3 audience Qs.
Jordan: assigning triage: Sam A, Mira B, Kai C, Anya moderator.
Anya: I'll draft landing + two social variants once CTAs are final. aiming to lock copy Tue.
Jordan: I'll scrub and upload sample logs for private demo by tomorrow EOD.
Kai: endpoint reserved: https://staging.redwood-demo/5310. ephemeral key provided at rehearsal.
ops-bot: Recording enabled. post-event asset will be in Marketing Drive.
